title: A bike repair stall
checked: Every reachable state checked (4 states, 7 with their data, 8 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 4 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
A bike is never marked fixed unless the new part went on.
rules.path: Take away the has the part guard and it breaks in 2 steps: next bike, fix it.

rules.rule: Every bike is ridden before it goes home
rules.says: The stall never hands back a bike nobody has test-ridden.
rules.path: Take away the ridden guard and it breaks in 5 steps: next bike, fix it, part arrives, fix it, hand back.
